messages:
pagerduty: INCIDENT: High 5xx rate on prod encoder canary. Alerting from error-budget rule. initial 5xx spike ~11% across canary nodes. Pd: P1.

jamie (oncall): Acked — I'm on it. Linking runbook.

jamie (oncall): Quick checks: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=encoder -o wide` -> lots of `CrashLoopBackOff` on encoder-canary pods, recent deploy 3m ago.

leo (eng-runtime): I see deploy diff: liveness probe path swapped in canary manifest, HPA minReplicas set to 0 in rollout. probably scale-to-zero + bad probe = restart storm during node-drain.

maria (sre): Prioritize aborting canary and reverting HPA. Proposed mitigations:
```
# abort canary and restore HPA
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/encoder-canary
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/encoder-canary --replicas=0
kubectl -n prod patch hpa/encoder-hpa --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":2}]'
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=encoder -o wide
```

jamie (oncall): Running `rollout undo` now. Posting logs as pods restart...

leo (eng-runtime): Logs snippet from encoder-canary:
```
E0317 12:15:02.123 main.go:45] failed liveness check: GET /healthz -> 500 "no such endpoint"
E0317 12:15:02.124 container runtime: SIGKILL due to OOM
```

support (ops): Customer impact: status page updated — ~10-12% of API requests to /v1/encode returned 503/502 for ~6 minutes. Estimating ~120 active customers touched, most degraded not fully down. Incident comms: posted short alert.

ana? ana (product): Can we get enterprise customer list for 1:1 notif? If high-impact, I'll draft email once we confirm rollback.

jamie (oncall): Rollout undo succeeded, HPA patched to minReplicas=2, scaling events observed. Monitoring metrics: 5xx dropped to 1.2% over last 2 min.

maria (sre): Handing off monitoring to next on-call: maria taking 30m watch. If 5xx > 5% for 10m, page eng-sre lead. Follow-up items: add CI check to prevent HPA minReplicas=0 for production canaries, and validate liveness probe path in manifest tests.

leo (eng-runtime): Filed issue #INF-3421 for probe lint + HPA guard. Adding test in manifest CI.

jamie (oncall): Noted customer-facing notes to send: brief explanation + ETA for postmortem. Support to confirm impacted customer list and send 1:1s after we stabilize.

support (ops): Confirmed list compiled, will hold until final state. Current metric: error rate 0.8% for 5 consecutive minutes. Status page updated: "Degraded - partial error rate affecting subset of requests; mitigation in progress".

ana? ana (product): Thanks. I'll prepare an email template and standby for approval.

maria (sre): Will keep monitoring, leaving trace sampling on for encoder service. Handoff to oncall until 12:40 UTC.

jamie (oncall): Closing active mitigation steps. Root cause hypothesis: canary manifest accidentally swapped liveness path + HPA allowed scale-to-zero leading to immediate pod churn during drain. Action items assigned in INF-3421.

maria (sre): Update: 12:38 UTC — error rate stable at 0.5%. Marking incident as mitigated. Will open full postmortem with timeline and customer impact summary.

support (ops): 12:40 UTC — customer 1:1s queued. Status page set to "Operational" after 10m stable window.

jamie (oncall): Thanks team. If anyone sees a regression, re-open thread or page. :thumbsup:
